page_title: AI Video Generator with Multiple AI Models | VidLux

sources.entry: VidLux AI - An all-in-one AI video creation platform for generating and editing videos from text, images, videos, and audio references. #freemium

summary.name: VidLux
summary.one_liner: VidLux is an AI video creation platform that generates and edits videos from text, images, and reference media using multiple third-party AI models.
use_cases: Turning product photos into showcase and launch videos
Creating reels and shorts from images and short scripts
Previewing campaign concepts and ad variations before production
Animating still images with camera movement
Previsualizing scripts and storyboards before filming
Testing character movement with motion references
summary.what_it_does: VidLux generates videos from a text prompt, an uploaded image, or a combination of image and reference media such as character, scene, style, motion, or audio references. It can animate a still image with motion and camera changes, create motion between a starting frame and an ending frame, and restyle an uploaded video while keeping its original motion and timing. It can also apply the movement from a reference video to an uploaded character image while keeping the character recognizable. The page says it offers multiple AI models, listing Kling, PixVerse, Seedance, Sora, Veo, Wan, Hailuo, Runway, Vidu and Grok, and it shows browsable example videos created with them.
notable: Access to multiple AI video models (Kling, Sora, Veo, Runway and others) in one platform
Start and end frame interpolation between two images
Video style transfer that keeps original motion and timing
Character motion transfer from a reference video to a character image
caveats: The page mentions credits, watermarks, commercial use and subscriptions in its FAQ section, but the FAQ answers are not included in the text, so specific terms are unknown
Freemium listing is from the directory; the page itself names a 'Start Creating Free' option but no plan details
